name: Ashirwad Capital Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, Ashirvad Capital Ltd is engaged in the business of investment[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is a Non Systematically Important Non Deposit Taking Non Banking Finance Company. It does investments in shares and securities. Apart from this, company is also in the business of manufacturing of Carvings of Precious and semi- precious stones, paintings, jewellery, etc. Company also receives compensation against property

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 351 days to 26.7 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 6.54% over last 3 years.
